plan.title: Switch RFQ to Auction After Template

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the initial event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title without affecting the event-type transition being tested.
Apply an RFQ template before switching event type.
Add one product so its retention can be checked after switching to Auction.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet before changing the event type.
Switch the single-stage event from RFQ to Auction.
Verify that the template picker now offers Auction templates distinct from RFQ templates.
Confirm that the product row remains after the event-type switch.
